description: The Rime-maul rehafted at the Colossus Anvil of Last Hearth on a longer haft of titan iron, its ice sheath drawn out to the grip of a great colossus: it fits stages 7 to 9. It still does not warm in the hand, and its heavy blows still chill what they strike.

perk.text: Heavies chill whatever they strike: slowed by 35% for 3 s
